Daily Devotional

November 6

18 And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God. (Mark 10:18 KJV)

This rich young ruler had come to Jesus and addressed Him as “Good Master”, and asked what he must do to be saved. Jesus questioned why he addressed Him as good, as only God is good. What Jesus was getting to, is that He should be recognized as being God, in order to be called good. The man then dropped the good and just called Jesus Master (Mark 10:20), as he did not recognize Jesus as being God in the flesh (John 1:1). If we think about it, there is none good but God, as we all are so far below His goodness, that we shouldn’t ever call ourselves good in the flesh. In comparison with God, or Jesus, all humans are so very far from being good. As Isaiah wrote, all our human righteousness is as filthy rags (Isaiah 64:6) when compared to the Lord.

This man asked what “he must do” in order to be saved, when all he needed to do was believe in the very one that he was talking to, and salvation would have been his. So many Christians today are asking this same question, as the churches have been teaching that God responds to what we do, instead of teaching the Gospel of Christ, or Good News, which is what Jesus has already done for us. All we have to do is believe on Jesus (John 20:31), and we will be saved. God sent His Grace through Jesus, so that all we have to do is have faith in the grace (Ephesians 2:8) to be saved, healed, prospered or delivered, and it has nothing to do with what we do other then our faith in Jesus and what He has already done, as well as our obedience (Hebrews 5:9). That is the Good News of the Gospel, and we need to enter into the Lord’s Rest as the Word teaches us (Hebrews 4:10). It is all about what Jesus did, and not about what we do, for our salvation. Thank you Jesus!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
